label: California Water Treatment Operator, Grade T1 (State Water Board)
purpose: Practice questions for the California State Water Resources Control Board Grade T1 Water Treatment Operator Examination. Original items in US units, written only from objectives the State Water Board marks as T1 in its Expected Range of Knowledge. Not an official exam blueprint.
reviewIntro: 250 original practice questions: 180 conceptual and 70 calculations, in US customary units, following the question counts by content category in the State Water Board's Expected Range of Knowledge for the T1 treatment exam (scaled from 100 to 250: source water 63, water treatment processes 62, operation and maintenance 50, laboratory procedures 38, regulations, administrative duties and safety 37). Only objectives marked for T1 are used. This is the first release size; more questions can be added later at the end of the source files. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.
